Description: Verify POST /sandbox/reset returns 200 with reset=true and seeded=true when SANDBOX_MODE=true, and reseeds the demo set (drivers 1-2, owners 1-2, lots 1-2, spots 1-4)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. JSON contains {'reset': true, 'seeded': true}
Post-Assertions: Execute SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM drivers WHERE id IN (1, 2) -> Expected: 2; SELECT count(*) FROM owners WHERE id IN (1, 2) -> Expected: 2; SELECT count(*) FROM lots WHERE id IN (1, 2) -> Expected: 2; SELECT count(*) FROM spots WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 4 -> Expected: 4
